div.div: مُسَافِحٌ (assumed tropical:) A fornicator. (TA.) And مُسَافِحَةٌ (assumed tropical:) A fornicatress; (TA;) a woman who does not abstain from fornication. (Aboo-Is-hák, TA.) اِبْنُ مُسَافِحَةٍ means (assumed tropical:) A son of a fornicatress; (TA;) and [in like manner] ↓ سَفِيحٌ a son who is the offspring of fornication. (Sgh, TA in art. عرض.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
